finding.observed: Multiple independent repository receipts use the same date, trigger and organ while claiming one unusual experiment, but they do not carry a shared trigger-level macrocycle identifier. Some are explicitly from other trigger variants such as go extra lang.
finding.counterhypothesis_rejected: Same timestamp/date/trigger/organ or nearby commit ancestry is sufficient to prove that receipts belong to one user-triggered go.
finding.reason: The project can run multiple separate go chats concurrently; those metadata fields collide across independent macrocycles.

repair.law: unusual-experiment slot comparison requires exact macrocycle_id equality
repair.upstream_requirement: orchestration layer mints and propagates one opaque macrocycle_id before spawning sibling organs
repair.legacy_behavior: no-ID receipts remain LEGACY_MACROCYCLE_ID_UNRESOLVED for cross-receipt adjudication; preserve their local observations/classifications
